title: Statistical Rates for Entropic Optimal Transport in the Discrete to SubGaussian Regime
abstract: arXiv:2609.26647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study statistical rates in entropic optimal transport in the semi-discrete regime where one measure has finite support and the other is subGaussian. Our main result establishes parametric convergence rates for the empirical dual potentials to their population counterparts, with no dimension dependence in the leading term. Our result relies on tailored strong concavity analysis of the semi-dual objective, coupled with specialized bounds for the semi-discrete potentials. As a consequence, we obtain fast rates for downstream quantities derived from the optimal coupling. Chiefly, the empirical barycentric projection achieves a squared-error rate $n^{-1}$, matching the fully compact case and improving over the less favorable $n^{-1/2}$ rate known for fully subGaussian settings. translated_title: 离散到次高斯情形下熵正则最优传输的统计收敛速率
translated_abstract: 我们研究了熵正则最优传输在半离散情形下的统计收敛速率，其中两个测度中一个具有有限支撑，另一个是次高斯的。我们的主要结果建立了经验对偶势对其总体对应物的参数化收敛速率，且主导项不依赖于维度。我们的结果依赖于对半对偶目标函数的定制化强凹性分析，并结合了针对半离散势函数的专门界。作为推论，我们为由最优耦合导出的下游量获得了快速收敛速率。其中最重要的是，经验重心投影达到了 n^{-1} 的平方误差速率，与完全紧支撑情形相匹配，并改进了完全次高斯情形下已知的较不利的 n^{-1/2} 速率。总而言之，这些结果可能表明存在一种“较低复杂度自适应”现象，即重心投影的统计复杂度由复杂度较低的测度所决定。
tldr: 本文建立了半离散情形下熵正则最优传输的经验对偶势的参数化收敛速率且主导项与维度无关，并证明经验重心投影达到 n^{-1} 的平方误差速率，与完全紧情形匹配且优于完全次高斯情形下的 n^{-1/2} 速率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes dimension-free parametric convergence rates for empirical dual potentials in semi-discrete entropic optimal transport, and shows that the empirical barycentric projection achieves an n^{-1} squared-error rate, matching the fully compact case and improving upon the n^{-1/2} rate known for fully subGaussian settings.
